$description: Primitive opacity tokens. Standardized alpha transparency levels for state overlays, backdrops, and disabled states.

transparent.$description: 0.0 full transparency for invisible hit areas and reset states

subtle.$description: 0.08 subtle alpha fill for hover state tinting and inactive container washes

muted.$description: 0.38 muted alpha for secondary placeholder text and subtle divider rules

disabled.$description: 0.48 standard opacity reduction for disabled non-interactive buttons and inputs

scrim.$description: 0.64 backdrop scrim darkness behind modal dialogs and side navigation drawers

solid.$description: 1.0 fully opaque surface and foreground element
